scope: Measurement only of one pinned instrumented baseline; no optimization or improvement claim. Four repetitions of three separate processes: fresh New Acc with empty user data, retained New Acc seeded from that repetition's fresh output, and Load seeded identically from r1-fresh. Cold OS/driver cache is untested. First process order and retained user data are different factors; these cases do not isolate cache warming. Inclusive phase and validation costs overlap and are never summed. Screenshot hashes verify evidence integrity, not visual correctness; visual review remains required. Four repetitions are descriptive, not statistical certainty.

source.scope: One current-master instrumented export on one Windows runner. All actions use new processes. Fresh means empty user data; retained is not warm-process. OS caches are not cleared. Diagnostic branch must not merge.
